meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Markdown 变成公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Markdown 写公众号,希望快速排版发布。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account articles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write WeChat posts in Markdown and want quick formatting and publishing.

howto.what: 该技能让Claude把Markdown文章转成微信公众号HTML,还能生成文章配图、创建草稿、按作者风格写作、准备标题建议,并去除AI写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当用户要求排版公众号文章、生成配图或封面、创建草稿、给出标题建议,或让文字更像人写时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇Markdown文章转成公众号HTML。
say.note: Claude会执行转化并给出预览或草稿。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成一张封面图。
say.note: Claude会调用封面生成流程输出图片。

say.text: 给这篇文章提几个标题建议。
say.note: Claude会生成标题候选供你选择。

howto.what_en: The skill lets Claude convert Markdown articles into WeChat Official Account HTML, generate article images, create drafts, write in creator styles, suggest titles, and remove AI writing traces.
howto.when_en: It triggers when users ask to format a WeChat article, generate cover or images, create a draft, get title suggestions, or make text more human-like.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown article to WeChat HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will convert and show preview or draft.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will run the cover generation flow.

say_en.text: Suggest a few titles for this article.
